title: Unlocated
summary: UNLO'CATED, adjective 1. Not place; not fixed in a place. 2. In America, unlocated lands are such new or wild lands as have not been surveyed, appropriated or designated by marks, limits or boundaries

inlines.v: UNLO'CATED, adjective 1. Not place; not fixed in a place. 2. In America, unlocated lands are such new or wild lands as have not been surveyed, appropriated or designated by marks, limits or boundaries, to some individual, company or corporation.
